rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for discarding or throwing something away.

example.english: I'll toss these scraps of paper.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 laan6 zi2 ngo5 diu6 zo2 keoi5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a light throw or, in the coin-tossing slice, for flipping a coin to decide something.

example.english: We'll toss a coin to decide who goes first.
example.traditional: 我哋掟個銀仔決定邊個先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deng3 go3 ngan4 zai2 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1

rows.note: Use this for turning and rolling restlessly, especially in bed when unable to sleep.

example.english: I can't sleep, so I toss and turn in bed.
example.traditional: 我瞓唔着，喺張床度反來反去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dou6 faan2 loi4 faan2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for tossing or mixing a salad and similar ingredients.

example.english: Remember to toss the salad evenly before eating.
example.traditional: 食之前記得撈勻個沙律。
example.jyutping: sik6 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 lou4 wan4 go3 saa1 leot6
